messages:
marie_support: Hey team, incoming customer report: rerank endpoint returning 400 for mobile app A on 1.2.3. Error in logs says 'Unexpected end of JSON input' and request body shows a wrapped field. Can we repro quickly?

sam_mobile: thanks marie. Customer is using our mobile SDK which posts multipart/form-data and puts the JSON in a form field named "payload". They say it worked earlier but started failing after a flaky network retry.

marie_support: can you paste the raw request that hit our api gateway?

sam_mobile: sure, here's a sanitized capture from their proxy:

```
POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary
...
------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="payload"

{"items": [{"id":"a1","text":"foo"},{"id":"a2","text":"bar"}], "top_k": 2}
------WebKitFormBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="attachments"; filename=""
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

<binary truncated>
------WebKitFormBoundary--
```

sam_mobile: but the gateway log shows we received: 

```
{"payload":"{\"items\":[{\"id\":\"a1\",\"text\":\"foo\"},{\"id\":\"a2\",\"text\":\"bar\"}], \"top_k\": 2
------WebKitFormBoundary"}
```

sam_mobile: looks like the client concatenated the multipart boundary into the JSON string when the body was truncated by the mobile SDK retry logic. Parser throws on the mixed content -> 400.

marie_support: server error was `400 Bad Request: payload must be a JSON object with non-empty items array`. But root cause is the payload field containing trailing boundary text.

deploy-bot: route /v1/rerank responded 400 for 8 requests/s in that window, all from same app version. No other endpoints affected.

laura_support: customer sent a minimal repro. They posted the form field as a string (not application/json). Repro steps: open app, trigger search -> triggers a multipart upload with empty attachment, network retry happens -> payload corrupted.

tom_engineer: suggested fixes: 1) quick-fix on gateway: if Content-Type is multipart/form-data and there's a "payload" field, attempt to parse the field and reject early with clearer error when it contains boundary markers or non-JSON chars. 2) longer-term: update mobile SDK to POST application/json for rerank RPCs (no attachments) and avoid doing retries that concatenate chunks.

marie_support: I asked customer to switch Content-Type to application/json as a fast repro. They did and got 200.

sam_mobile: SDK action item: add validation on SDK side to never wrap JSON in form fields for pure JSON RPCs; add test for retry logic that preserves boundaries. Also bump mobile SDK and publish patch.

laura_support: opened ticket SUP-6482, assigned to mobile team. Customer ok with patch and will delay upgrade until patch released. Marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:

marie_support: notes for KB: common cause of rerank 400 -> 
- payload field contains multipart boundary or trailing bytes (network truncation/concat)
- items field stringified inside another field (server receives a string not array)
- top_k present but items empty after parse -> 400

marie_support: sample server-side defensive snippet to add to gateway logs for easier triage: ```if (typeof body.payload === 'string' && /----WebKitFormBoundary/.test(body.payload)) { log('multipart-wrapped-json'); return 400; }```

marie_support: closing notes: customer will test SDK patch in next build. Will re-open if we see more 400 spikes.
